utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You have just heard the decision of the Trial Chamber, and I should like to give the floor to Mr. Lukic at this point and ask him whether he has explained to his client the significance of the present amendments and, in particular, counts 11 and 14.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honours. I explained to my defendant in detail all the changes, and right now we want to waive the right of reading the whole indictment. If the Chamber finds it appropriate, certain portions could be read to my defendant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Mr. Lukic, for your concern and attention. We will do just what you have suggested. Mr. Stakic, would you please rise. Dr. Stakic, have you understood the meaning of the new amendments; that is, the meaning of counts 11 and 14? Have they been explained to you by your counsel?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Stakic, are you ready to enter a plea on the basis of these new counts; that is, to state whether you feel guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well, then. I am now going to ask Madam Registrar to read only count 11 at this point, count 11 of the indictment, please, that is, of the new indictment against the accused, so that we can hear the new wording of the count.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 11: Inhumane acts, forcible transfer, a crime against humanity, punishable under Articles 5(i) and 7(1) and 7(3) of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Dr. Stakic, how do you plead, guilty or not guilty, to this new count of the indictment, count number 11?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Madam Registrar, can we now have count number 14, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Count 14: Plunder of private or public property, a violation of the laws or customs of war, punishable under Articles 3(e) and 7(1) and 7(3) of the Statute of the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Dr. Stakic, how do you plead, guilty or not guilty, in respect of count number 14 of the indictment?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. You may be seated, Dr. Stakic. Madam Registrar, may the record reflect that Dr. Stakic has pleaded not guilty in respect of counts 11 and 14 of the indictment.
